Hello, Gonçalo.

I’m Gessika, founder of Lola Lab. I’m glad you reached out. Besides PIETRA, the studio also works with image, video, voice and music, and I bring 23 years of advertising experience.
Brazilian and Italian, between Brazil and Lisbon, working remotely with clients worldwide. You can see more at lolalabstudio.com, and I’m here for whatever you need.
PIETRA · self-initiated project
Manifesto
To the ones who never picked a lane.
Who draw, write, film, code. And still want to learn one more thing.
Tired of hearing “choose a side”? Artist or technician. Human or machine.
They’re here for the new game: doing alone what used to take an army, with a taste of their own.
Da Vinci. Lamarr. Kubrick. Lynch.  They crossed every line someone drew.
Learn everything. Connect everything. Whoever links what nobody linked invents what doesn’t exist yet.
Be too much.
Lola Lab. The studio for people who do all of it.
Lola Lab.
